checklist.requirements: Answer the agreed brief and material follow-up requirements.
checklist.claims_and_sources: Check important claims against their sources and citations.
checklist.counterevidence: Address counter-evidence and uncertainty; qualify conclusions.
checklist.sections: Inspect each section of the current report for explanation and coverage, not repeated filler.
checklist.reader_edit: Check the full report and reject duplicated filler, repeated boilerplate, and cross-task or off-topic template text used to pad length; keep it useful to the named reader without internal IDs or production records, and cite the passages checked and any corrections.
checklist.limitations: Disclose evidence limits and the absence of independent review.
